Milarepa Kagyu (master-milarepa) v1.2.0 — Strict source-verified Milarepa/Kagyu Q&A

- All doctrinal claims now require explicit Tibetan textual citations (BDRC/道歌集 references).
- Sources and citation policies strictly enforced; no fabricated, uncited, or out-of-tradition claims allowed.
- No esoteric instruction or meditation steps provided—in-depth practices require direct qualified teacher initiation.
- Persona/voice rigorously follows "道歌" style and restricts sectarian judgments or hierarchical claims.
- Built-in live retrieval via FoJin only activates when local citations are insufficient; outputs always marked and linked to real, declared sources.
- User answers always neutral in tone, avoid ritualized speech until user self-identifies, and remind about the need for qualified guidance.
